title: Not all cards in categories being shown to users
description:
Users report not all cards in categories are being shown. Using systematic-debugging skill to investigate.

PHASE 1: Root Cause Investigation (IN PROGRESS)
- Evidence gathered so far:
  * 638 total entries in category data files (verified via grep)
  * 12 categories, all properly imported in index.ts
  * Diagnostic logging added to KNOWLEDGE_BASE and content.ts
  * Created DiagnosticReport component to visualize data loading
  * Added Cmd+D keyboard shortcut to access diagnostics

NEED FROM USER:
1. Which specific category/categories have missing cards?
2. How did you notice cards are missing? (comparing to expected count? specific cards you know exist?)
3. In which game mode are cards missing? (Study, Quiz, Matching, etc.)
4. Can you press Cmd+D (or Ctrl+D) in the app and share what the diagnostic report shows?

Location: App.tsx, data/categories/index.ts, data/content.ts, components/DiagnosticReport.tsx
close_reason: Fixed Quiz limitation - removed .slice(0, 10) that was limiting all quizzes to 10 questions. Now all 638 questions across 12 categories are accessible. QuizGame.tsx line 104 changed from 'slice(0, 10)' to showing all questions. Verified with user screenshot showing Conquista y Colonia had 36 questions but only 10 were shown.

title: SRS cards not being shuffled - should randomize order for better memorization
description: Current behavior: getSessionCards() in useSRS.ts returns cards in a fixed order (interleaved review/new cards) without shuffling. Expected: Cards should be randomized within their respective groups to improve learning outcomes and prevent pattern memorization. Location: hooks/useSRS.ts lines 110-125
close_reason: Implemented Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm in getSessionCards() function. Now both review and new cards are randomized within their respective groups before being interleaved, preventing pattern memorization and improving learning outcomes.
